scope: Same original runtime/session/source Binding resource lifetime and actual original WK bridge
lifecycle: Producer attaches the same runtime/session/parent task before execution; no new JVM/session/credential/cache owner.
Attach captures indexed initiallyTracked presence. First-page deletion of an existing source cannot be recast as an unsaved public source.
LocalPage exact six metadata keys/session/parent/aliases are validated; the existing prefetchedHTML is the only prepared body.
Nonawait normal completion and later ordinary script failure release producer participation; real page continues with same session/owner.
Each WK request registers a cancellable child and Host invocation under that page, validates live indexed source mutation and binding, bypasses the waiting parent source service gate.
Source changes use the existing sourcesPublisher and index. A single-source signature is recalculated off main only after a store mutation; unchanged children reuse the checked mutation token.
Awaited children are capped by parent deadline; retained nonawait page children each have their own bounded 30 second deadline.

Presenter drains mounted initial-load/cookie/confirmation and new WebJS tasks, closes the JVM page environment, then releases the page; final close(session)/revoke occurs only after producer and pages ended.

Page close never waits for its parent still blocked in source.browser. Explicit cancel/source invalidation closes the real page; presentation rejection before queuing also releases the already registered lease.
bridge: The original Presenter keeps sourceRunHandler nil. Existing legacy JSC/source Java prompt behavior is unchanged for other callers.
Generated java/cache native aliases are installed only for nonempty final prefetched HTML, before the locked original JS2 runs; empty POST navigates without installing a bridge.
Promise request reply returns callback identity only. The original JSBridgeResult then synchronously gets/deletes its own existing memory result and removes its own callback.
Prompt and message callbacks use independently owned tasks; no Swift lane is retained while JS synchronously reenters cache prompts.
Original nullable String, string-list and void are preserved; string null and absent cache null remain different.

Typed async error maps are handled before callback-shape checking. If the closed cache channel rejects a fallback, reject/remove the original callback with its primary error without creating another result store.

preFreezeFindingsClosed.before: Lazy admission started tracked=false even if an owned source was deleted before the first page.
preFreezeFindingsClosed.after: Attach stores the existing indexed presence fact; first-page admission inherits it and rejects missing previously owned source.
Preserve reply.error before shape validation; original cache/promise retains the typed code.

limits: No Swift compiler, Apple SDK, actual WK/UIApplication, JNI or new Native method executed here. Grammar and Node are not substitutes.
Node executes the exact locked original JS_INJECTION2 plus the candidate bootstrap with a controlled prompt/message fixture. It does not prove the real Host/JVM/WK integration.
Backend ordinary-JAR/HTTP evidence belongs to its separately frozen parent. This Swift author did not recompile or rerun those JVM cases.
Only finite explicit-login local HTML/WebJS is wired. General showBrowser/verification-flight and unported inherited UI/file/crypto APIs remain unsupported.
Source invalidation seals future child/Host admission and drains issued work. A mutation accepted before that seal retains its actual effects; no rollback or atomic cross-owner delete is claimed.
